items.name: Zeta Supreme Combo
items.description: Test Zeta's flagship combo -- a main plus two bundle slots with NO autoFill default, so both start vacant until a standalone side/drink is absorbed or the model explicitly picks one. #283: the open drinks slot (never autofilled) is what lets this pack qualify for ComboComponentResizeConformanceTests' Discovered_* theories, which require a real, non-wholeBundleSize, non-componentUpcharge persona whose own bundle genuinely leaves a drink slot open.

items.name: Zeta Value Combo
items.description: Test Zeta's second, distinctly-named combo -- also a drinks-only bundle slot with NO autoFill, so a test can seed TWO separate bundle instances at once (#283, mirroring #184 round 3 item H(b)'s DiscoverTwoInstance) and verify a by-name drink resize targets only the instance holding that exact item.

items.name: Zeta Cola
items.description: Test Zeta's house cola -- the fixture's only multi-size, real (non-autoFill-only) comboSlot drink, used by the combo-component-resize tests to prove resizing an included-any-size slot item never changes the bundle's own total.

items.name: Zeta Lemonade
items.description: Test Zeta's lemonade -- a SECOND real, single-size comboSlot drink, distinct from Zeta Cola, so a test can seed two separate bundle instances with two distinguishable drinks and verify a by-name resize targets only the instance holding that exact item.

items.name: Zeta Fries
items.description: Test Zeta's standalone fries -- a real side a guest can order before the combo, so bundle-pivot absorption (not autoFill, which this pack never has) fills Zeta Supreme Combo's own sides slot.
